title: Two Graphyard installs on one host share each agent account's concurrency and quota holds
description: Two temporary installs on one host whose registries name the same login home with a per-account limit of 1: while the first install holds a live session on the account, the second's selection passes it over and its registry names the other install as the holder; when the session ends — released by the registry session's end, or by killing the launcher process, which the kernel's lock drop clears at once — the second install selects it. An account one install marks exhausted until a time is ineligible in the other until that time. An install alone on the host is unaffected.
